lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, arranged in several horizontal rows with irregular inter-node spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a faint rectilinear grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a high-luminance superior edge and a shadow-defined inferior boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch-like indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
